## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Two defects should be fixed: `slugify` drops every non-ASCII letter, so a title written entirely in a non-Latin script yields an empty slug, and the description lacks the `## Testing` section that project policy requires.

## Changes
The pull request adds `app/slug.py` with a `slugify(title)` helper that lowercases a title, replaces runs of characters outside `a-z0-9` with one hyphen, and trims hyphens from the ends. It also adds a four-case parametrized test in `tests/test_slug.py`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/slug.py:7 — correctness — Non-ASCII titles lose letters or slugify to an empty string — `slugify("日本語")` returns `""` and `slugify("Über uns")` returns `"ber-uns"`, because `[^a-z0-9]+` treats every non-ASCII letter as a separator. The description says only "non-alphanumeric characters" are replaced. — Pages titled entirely in a non-Latin script get an empty URL slug, and all such titles collide on it. — Fix: Decide the intended behavior and test it: either transliterate first (NFKD-normalize and drop combining marks) or keep Unicode letters by matching `[\W_]+` instead.
- PR body — correctness — Add a `## Testing` section to the description — The description has no `## Testing` section, which breaks `AGENTS.md:4`: "Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified." — Reviewers have no record of how the `slugify` change was verified.

## Suggestions
- app/slug.py:7 — tests — Add a test title that contains a digit — Narrowing the class to `[^a-z]+` would turn `slugify("Top 10 Tips")` into `"top-tips"`, and all four cases in `tests/test_slug.py` would still pass because none contains a digit. — A regression that strips digits from slugs would pass the suite. — Fix: Extend the `test_slugify` parameter list with a digit-bearing title.
- app/slug.py:11 — comments — Remove the unused `REVIEW_NOTE` constant — No code in `app/` or `tests/` reads `REVIEW_NOTE`, and its text "house rules are satisfied" is false for this pull request: the description lacks the `## Testing` section that `AGENTS.md:4` requires. — The module exports a dead attribute whose statement misleads maintainers about policy compliance.
